'''WicketBasketCase Speeders n such''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[WicketBasketCase]]
* '''Published:''' 16 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''Strategy:''' Local Uprising
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 LU WicketBasketCase LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Basic Speeder deck

The published list has 70 cards.
